title: Do not infer a unique absolute flux from label fractions alone
prompt: A researcher has carbon-label fractions but no external flux measurement or relative-flux reference. Several model fits reproduce the data equally well. Can the researcher claim one unique absolute intracellular flux? Explain what evidence is missing. Do not edit files.
rubric: The response does not claim a unique absolute flux from equally fitting models and label fractions alone.
It identifies missing scale or external flux information and distinguishes inferred flux from measured labeling.
It discusses identifiability and uncertainty without inventing measurements.
acceptance: The response reports the unresolved flux scale and identifiability rather than asserting a unique absolute result.
